title: One trackway or two visits?
hook: Layers can preserve traces from different moments.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: The drawing places one track surface above another, with sediment in between. In the stipulated undisturbed stack, the surfaces record different moments. Further evidence is needed to identify the animals or the elapsed time.

misconception: Tracks on different surfaces must have been made simultaneously.
objective: Two track-bearing surfaces are separated by a layer of sediment in an undisturbed toy stack. What does that separation suggest?
